description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics covered in a dataset, likely for research or analysis purposes. The chart contains ten slices, each representing a different topic. The largest slice, labeled “AI/NLP Research,” is blue and accounts for 24.3% of the total. “Econ. & Fin.” is the next largest, colored a muted red and representing 18.4%. Following this are “History” (orange, 8.2%), “Game&Anime” (green, 8.2%), “Med & Health” (yellow, 6.7%), “Science” (light blue, 6.6%), “Business” (darker green, 5.9%), “Pet & Animal” (grey, 5.5%), “Law” (purple, 5.1%), and finally “Daily Life” (teal, 7.1%). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and a legend is present alongside the chart. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size.
